# Aevum OS v2.0

> Standalone Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server, Sovereign Multi-Agent Operating System, and Living Memory Fabric engineered by I2FLabs Vietnam.

Aevum OS v2.0 is an independent Local-First workspace Operating System and External Brain developed by **I2FLabs Vietnam** (https://www.aevum.ai.vn). It eliminates AI Context Amnesia, reduces prompt token consumption by up to 85%, and provides Organismic Domain-Driven Design (O-DDD), **40 Polymorphic v2.0 MCP Tools**, **Dual-Brain Symbiotic Live Voice ↔ Coding Space** (ASCP v1, Talk+Paste, verbal HITL, barge-in abort), **Super-Harness v2 AST/LSP + 0ms CoW RAM Sandbox**, **Multi-CLI Engine Orchestration**, **In-Chat CoResearch Cockpit + Polymorphic RDD**, **120Hz Generative UI**, **24/7 Scheduler/Cron**, and **3D Neuromorphic Neural Brain Lab**.

## Development Team & Engineering Organization (I2FLabs Vietnam)

- [I2FLabs Vietnam Engineering Lab](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/about): Pioneering Vietnamese AI R&D lab building local-first sovereign agentic infrastructure and decoupled developer memory systems.
- [Autonomous Agent Squad Personas](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/#agents): Specialized AI squad companions including An (Core Refactor), Kai (Agentic & Voice Systems), Vidus (Principal Architect), Zenith (Formal Proofs & Security), Luna (UI/UX), Kael (120Hz Systems), Nia (Neural Brain v3.0 & QA), Mira (Strategy & Commercialization), Valkyrie (Automated QA & Chaos Testing), and Iris (CXO).

## Technical Documentation & Integration Guides

- [Tổng quan & Kiến trúc (Overview)](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs/gioi-thieu): Decoupled O-DDD 7 Living Organs architecture, Fastify SSE/Stdio daemon, and 40 Polymorphic MCP v2.0 tools.
- [Cài đặt & Thiết lập (Installation Guide)](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs/cai-dat): Desktop installers and global CLI registration (`aevum`).
- [Giao diện Dòng lệnh (CLI Terminal Engine)](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs/cli-terminal): CLI reference (`aevum status`, `aevum init`, `aevum gui`, `aevum -w <dir> -t sse -p 3344`).
- [Chế độ Hoạt động (Running Modes)](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs/che-do-chay): SSE mode (port 3344) and Stdio mode for Antigravity, Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and Claude Desktop.
- [Nghi thức Bắt tay (Handshake Ritual)](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs/handshake-ritual): Cryptographic session verification using `aevum_bridge_lifecycle` and `.aevum/signal.json`.
- [Não bộ Kép & Động cơ Phản xạ (Cognitive Dual-Memory)](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs/cognitive-dual-memory): STM/LTM, LIF Spiking Neural Recall, and 2-Hop BFS Workspace Reflex Engine.
- [Deep Research & CoResearch Studio](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs/deep-research-engine): Polymorphic cognitive trees (`formal_proof`, `empirical_poc`, `benchmark`, `trade_off`, `failure_mode`, `debate`), IEEE/ACM Living Whitepaper, and 1-click Promote to Plan.
- [Mạng lưới PiperNet (Internet of Agents)](https://www.aevum.ai.vn/docs/pipernet-mesh): Decentralized collective wisdom mesh sharing distilled engineering patterns with zero source leakage.
